io.milvus.bulkwriter.restful

Class DataVolumeUtils

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.bulkwriter.restful.BaseRestful
      • io.milvus.bulkwriter.restful.DataVolumeUtils

  • public class DataVolumeUtils
extends BaseRestful
    REST helper for managing Milvus data volumes used by the bulk writer.

    Provides methods to apply, list, create, describe, and delete data volumes through the Milvus /v2/volumes REST API. Volume operations let the bulk writer allocate and manage the remote storage volume that holds the uploaded data files.
